facts.fact: Archie 的手臂仍吊在三角巾里，人却兴致很好，正在荷李活道与 Possession Street 的街角跟轿夫们说话。
facts.anchor: Archie’s arm was still in a sling, but he was in good spirits, conversing with the sedan-chair men at the corner of Hollywood Road and Possession Street.

facts.fact: 一个嚼着烟叶的轿夫问他是不是她的鬼佬。
facts.anchor: “Ah mui, is this gweilo yours?” one of the chair men said, chewing on a wad of tobacco.

facts.fact: 她赶紧说他是朋友，Archie 疑惑地看她。
facts.anchor: “He’s a friend,” Kiamling said quickly as Archie looked at her inquisitively.

facts.fact: 她改用客家话骂那个下流的家伙。
facts.anchor: Kiamling switched to Hakka to swear at the perverted fool

facts.fact: 她原本的打算是把自己变得更像 Jingling。
facts.anchor: Her plan had been to be more Jingling.

facts.fact: 为这一趟她洗了脸、梳了头，还换了一身干净衣裳。
facts.anchor: She had washed her face, brushed her hair and put on a fresh outfit for the occasion.

facts.fact: 她刚开口提钱，就为自己糟糕的措辞懊恼。
facts.anchor: “Speaking of money…” she began, wincing at her own terrible choice of words.

facts.fact: Archie 打断她，说收到了妹妹的信。
facts.anchor: “I received a letter from my younger sister,” Archie interrupted before she could go on.

facts.fact: 他承认自己没问过家人想不想，只说这对所有人都是往上一步。
facts.anchor: “I didn’t ask. It would be a step up in the world for all of them, and that’s the most important thing, right?”

facts.fact: 听完这些，她开不了口向他借钱。
facts.anchor: Either way, she could not ask Archie to lend her money, not after hearing that.

facts.fact: 她说鸦片馆老板留了话，招呼他跟她走。
facts.anchor: “The owner left me a message. Come on.”

facts.fact: 雕花窗板上被抠出深深的抓痕，木料有几处裂开。
facts.anchor: Deep scratch marks were gouged in the ornate slats, the wood splintering in places.

facts.fact: 他买的盐多到能把全岛的蔬菜都腌了。
facts.anchor: He had bought enough to brine every vegetable on the island.

facts.fact: Ng Choy 仍待在他们上次见他的那间房里。
facts.anchor: Ng Choy was still in the chamber where they had last seen him.

facts.fact: Ng Choy 律师躺在整整一圈罂粟的正中央。
facts.anchor: Barrister Ng Choy was at the centre of a perfect circle of poppies.

facts.fact: 他摸到罂粟花瓣时手在抖，脸上血色全褪。
facts.anchor: A blanched terror made his hands tremble as they touched the petals of one of the poppies.

facts.fact: 她让马先生今晚关掉烟馆，要做一场驱邪。
facts.anchor: “Ma sang, close the den. Tonight we will do an exorcism.”

facts.fact: 她说英国把自己的怪物带过了海。
facts.anchor: “The British. You’ve brought your own monsters across the ocean.”

facts.fact: 她最后说，因为他是女巫的儿子。
facts.anchor: “Because you are the son of a witch.”
